governance_layers: Layer 1: Application budget ($0.05/call) — blocks before gateway
Layer 2: Gateway rate limit (5/min) — blocks at gateway entry
Layer 3: Gateway guardrails (PII + safety + keywords) — blocks after tokenization
Layer 4: Inference table logging — records all attempts (blocked and passed)
